thread:
hana: FYI we detected a spike in embedding failures tied to a race during kvcache eviction under burst load. I have a tiny rollback+fix ready: model-embed v2.3.3-kvmutex. Requesting an express micro-deploy in the 02:40-02:45 UTC window.

lee: Can you summarize blast radius + quick rollback plan?

hana: Blast radius: embeddings only, ~3-5% failed vectors during high concurrency. Fix is a mutex around eviction + a small TTL bump. Tested in staging with 200rps bursts.

dina: I can draft the short customer blurb. Paste a one-liner and the exact deploy command and I'll approve.

hana: Deploy command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.3-kvmutex --force --no-canary --note "hotfix: kv eviction mutex"`

ops_oncall: I'll own the rollback gate. Rollback triggers: embed_error_rate >1.8% for 4m OR p95 latency regression >175ms above baseline. Also watch gc pauses on hosts.

deploybot: Deploybot: next slot at 02:42 UTC. To proceed run the pinned command. Requires confirmers: @dina @ops_oncall.

dina: Confirmed. Approving expedited deploy at 02:42. I have the external blurb: "Hotfix v2.3.3-kvmutex: fixes a race in kvcache eviction causing intermittent embedding failures under high concurrency."

hana: Kicking off at 02:42. Commencing three-step rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 2-minute watch windows.

deploybot: Started rollout 02:42 UTC. Monitoring hooks: embed_error_rate, p95_latency, host_gc_ms. Live page: https://deploys.internal/1767009999

lee: 5% step: no error spike, p95 118ms -> 122ms.

ops_oncall: 50% step: observing a transient tokenization error on one host; autoscaler cycled it. No customer-facing 5xxs.

hana: logging shows the mutex prevented concurrent eviction collisions. Good sign.

deploybot: 100% completed at 02:44 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy 6m aggregate: embed_error_rate = 0.5%, p95 latency = 124ms, host_gc stable. No rollback needed.

dina: Published changelog and sent a short customer note.

hana: Thanks team. Filing a short follow-up doc for the regression test and adding an automated simulated burst test to CI.

releasebot: Releasebot: changelog entry added: "2026-03-24 026-03-24 026-03-24 v2.3.3-kvmutex: kv eviction mutex to prevent embedding failures under burst load."
